story.text:
# What changes

**Stated changes.** "aesthetics is like an expression we've got the arts community firmly involved we've got the environmental community... involved." There is now "a visual picture" — "a bit like... the blue marble earthrise thing we now see what it looks like... we can prove it's round." This "is leading up to the agm" and "now motivates people who are not so interested in the words" so they "feel it" and "say i'd like to turn up to july the fourth." The substrate becomes accessible: extending Max's vibe-coded Oasis IDE so "anyone can vibe code it" while "still retain a value to that whole methodology," providing a "canonical interface and a focusable diversity of interface to all the good stuff."

**Hedged or possible.** "we'll have more diverse expressions of the hitchhiker so we'll have these like musicians who might like literally at their concerts say like something to do with hitchhikers." Possibly "an influx of new types of hitchhikers and that will be a fairly significant change." Branding/domains hedged: "multiple brand and possibly multiple domain names is a open... question."
